response.sql: WITH c AS (SELECT f.rating, COUNT(i.inventory_id) AS copies FROM inventory i JOIN film f ON f.film_id = i.film_id GROUP BY f.rating), a AS (SELECT AVG(copies) AS avg_copies FROM c) SELECT SUM(c.copies) AS total_copies, AVG(c.copies - a.avg_copies) AS avg_excess FROM c CROSS JOIN a WHERE c.copies > a.avg_copies
